steps.en: Install from the git source (the PyPI name in the README is not published)
steps.zh: 从 git 源码安装（README 里的 PyPI 包名并未发布）

steps.en: Scan a repo root; your home-directory agent configs are included by default
steps.zh: 扫描一个仓库根目录，默认连同家目录下的 agent 配置

steps.en: Visits known skill, agent, command and MCP config locations and lists what exists
steps.zh: 走一遍已知的 skill、命令与 MCP 配置位置，列出清单

steps.en: Runs offline regex, syntax-tree and permission rules, then cross-checks item pairs
steps.zh: 离线跑正则、语法树与权限规则，再做跨项交叉检查

steps.en: Save this state as the baseline, then re-run later against it
steps.zh: 把当前状态存为基线，之后再跑一次与它对比

steps.en: Reports what changed since the baseline and exits non-zero above your threshold
steps.zh: 报告相对基线的变化，超过阈值时以非零码退出

value.en: One report of every agent extension on the machine, and a diff when one of them changes
value.zh: 一份报告列全机器上的 agent 扩展，哪个变了会给出差异

sources: README Drift + provenance (skillscan scan --save-baseline; re-run with --baseline)
